operation.body:
### Goal

Complete the final documentation consistency pass required before project #2 can close: project-facing docs must honestly describe FR-001–FR-008 as delivered on `main`, including FR-008 delivery evidence (goal #23, PR #24) and current reproducibility commands.

### Acceptance criteria

- `README.md` status and delivery-evidence table reflect FR-001–FR-008 on `main`, include FR-008 (`db:seed`), and link goal [#23](https://github.com/szymoniwacz/feedback-index-test-2/issues/23) and [PR #24](https://github.com/szymoniwacz/feedback-index-test-2/pull/24).
- `.ai/project/roadmap.md`, `.ai/project/product-context.md`, and `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` status/readiness sections state FR-001–FR-008 complete (no “remaining FR-008” or “in progress” for reproducibility).
- `docs/demo-guide.md` remains aligned with verified local commands (`db:prepare`, `db:seed`, `bin/rails test`); no fabricated execution evidence.
- Pull request contains exact `Closes #<this-issue-number>`; documentation-only; no edits to `docs/security-review.md` or goal #3 scope.
- `bin/rails test` passes; CI green on the pull request.

### Constraints

- Ruby on Rails documentation-only change on current default branch tip (`4a94109` or later).
- No new product features; no authentication; MIT license unchanged.
- Inherit project `self-correcting-review auto-merge` authorization.

### Out of scope

- Goal #3 security checklist; demo video; production hosting.

### Relevant context

Goal #23 (FR-008) merged via PR #24 with seeds and demo commands, but README, roadmap, product-context, and requirements intro still describe FR-008 as pending. Project completion criteria require a final consistency pass per `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` acceptance details.

<!-- project-executor:goal project=szymoniwacz/feedback-index-test-2#2 -->
operation.title: [Agent Goal]: Final documentation consistency for project completion
